question: A category is ready for human review, but the assessment also records a shipment-global blocker. Which aggregate action state takes precedence?
reviewer_rationale: SOP-01#state-precedence explicitly puts a shipment-global blocker ahead of any ready category, yielding NEEDS_REVIEW. It is the sole required support for this ordering question; the question supplies the blocker scope and does not ask how the blocker was detected.
